1.w: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, To the saints being in Ephesus, and faithful in Christ Jesus:

2.w: Grace to you⁺ and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

3.w: Blessed [be] the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the One having blessed us with every spiritual blessing in Christ in the heavenly realms,

4.w: just as He chose us in Him before the foundation of the world for us to be holy and blameless before Him, in love

5.w: having predestined us to adoption as sons through Jesus Christ to Himself, according to the good pleasure of His will,

6.w: to the praise of the glory of His grace, which He graciously gave us in the Beloved One,

7.w: in whom we have redemption through His blood, the forgiveness of trespasses, according to the riches of His grace,

8.w: which He abounded to us in all wisdom and understanding,

9.w: having made known to us the mystery of His will according to His good pleasure, which He purposed in Him

10.w: for the administration of the fullness of the times, to bring together all things in Christ—the things in the heavens and the things upon the earth—

11.w: in Him, in whom also we obtained an inheritance, having been predestined according to the purpose of the One working all things according to the counsel of His will

12.w: for us to be to the praise of His glory, the ones having first hoped in Christ,

13.w: in whom you⁺ also, having heard the word of truth, the gospel of your⁺ salvation, in whom also having believed, you⁺ were sealed with the Holy Spirit of promise,

14.w: who is the pledge of our inheritance to the redemption of the acquired possession, to the praise of His glory.

15.w: Because of this, I also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus among you⁺ and the love to all the saints,

16.w: do not cease giving thanks for you⁺, making remembrance in my prayers,

17.w: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you⁺ a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of Him,

18.w: the eyes your⁺ of heart being enlightened for you⁺ to know what is the hope of His calling, what [are] the riches of the glory of His inheritance in the saints,

19.w: and what [is] the surpassing greatness of His power to us, those believing, according to the working of the power of His strength,

20.w: which He worked in Christ, having raised Him out from the dead, and having seated [Him] at His right hand in the heavenly realms,

21.w: far above every principality and authority and power and lordship and every name being named, not only in this age, but also in the one about to be.

22.w: And He subjected all things under His feet and gave Him [to be] head over all things to the church,

23.w: which is His body, the fullness of the One filling all in all.
